item.title: Data Lakes and ETL for Backend Engineers
item.description: A data lake keeps raw data cheaply and leaves structure to whoever reads it. Moving data between the raw, staging, and mart layers is the transformation called ETL/ELT, and Spark is the engine that runs it across many machines. Written for backend engineers used to service databases.
